mapper.select: SELECT A.PT_DLYS_SEQ AS hdNo, A.HEMO_MCNR_NO || ' (' || (SELECT Z.COMN_CD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCCCCSTE Z WHERE Z.COMN_GRP_CD = 'N0003037' AND Z.COMN_CD = A.DLYS_REC_HEMO_KND_CD) || ')' AS machineNo, A.DLYS_TRP_TM_CNTE AS duration, A.DLFL_INJT_SPD_NM AS dfr, (SELECT Z.COMN_CD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCCCCSTE Z WHERE Z.COMN_GRP_CD = 'N0007011' AND Z.COMN_CD = A.DLYS_FRVS_RMDE_TP_CD) AS patientType, A.BDLY_BDWT AS currentPreWeight, A.ADLY_BDWT AS currentPostWeight, A.BDLY_BDWT - A.ADLY_BDWT AS currentWeightLost, NULL AS uf, CASE WHEN A.PT_DLYS_SEQ = 1 THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT Z.ADLY_BDWT FROM ODS.S_MRNNRHBD Z WHERE Z.PT_NO = A.PT_NO AND Z.PT_DLYS_SEQ = (A.PT_DLYS_SEQ - 1) AND Z.DLYS_TP_CD = 'A' AND Z.LST_YN = 'Y') END AS beforePostWeight, A.LST_DBW_VAL::float AS dryWeight, CASE WHEN A.PT_DLYS_SEQ = 1 THEN NULL ELSE A.BDLY_BDWT - (SELECT Z.ADLY_BDWT FROM ODS.S_MRNNRHBD Z WHERE Z.PT_NO = A.PT_NO AND Z.PT_DLYS_SEQ = (A.PT_DLYS_SEQ - 1) AND Z.DLYS_TP_CD = 'A' AND Z.LST_YN = 'Y') END AS beforeWeightGain, A.WHL_UFLT_NM AS tuf, (SELECT Z.COMN_CD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCCCCSTE Z WHERE Z.COMN_GRP_CD = 'N0003029' AND Z.COMN_CD = A.PRMN_FLUD_TP_CD) AS primingFluid, A.DLYS_MDPR_NM AS fluidType, A.DLYS_MCNR_NM AS machineType, A.BLVE_KND_NM AS bloodVesselType, A.PRMN_FMPS_NM As primingStfNm, A.DLYS_STR_FMPS_NM AS startStfNm, A.DLYS_CFMT_FMPS_NM AS assignStfNm, A.DLYS_END_FMPS_NM AS finishStfNm FROM ODS.S_MRNNRHBD A WHERE A.PT_NO || '_' || A.PT_DLYS_SEQ = #{keyId} AND A.DLYS_TP_CD = 'A' AND A.LST_YN = 'Y'
